gameOption.baseDescription: STANDARD uses cells 2–12 per row. LONGO uses cells 2–16 with bonus numbers.
gameOption.gameModeDescription: ONLINE enforces turn order and dice rules on the server. OFFLINE lets players use real dice.
gameOption.cardModeDescription: Some options (like Extra row) always generate a unique layout per player, overriding this setting.
gameOption.randomOrderDescription: Shuffle the display values within each row.
gameOption.extraRowDescription: Add a bonus row of cells forming a wave across the four rows.
gameOption.connectedCellsDescription: Link cells between adjacent rows: crossing one auto-crosses the connected cell in the next row.

rowClosure.confirmQuestion: Do you want to change your last selection?
rowClosure.selfClose: Do you want to close this row?
